findings.reason: one shared predicate and one heading locator should be extended in `reckon/_store.py`, and §10's design should name that owner rather than add a soup-side copy.
findings.text: `_inside_structured_region` re-implements the "Reckon structured region vs authored section wrapper" predicate already owned by `_store._is_structural_boundary` (`reckon/_store.py:820`, same `data-reckon not in (None, "section")` rule, along with the two inline spellings at `reckon/_store.py:772` and `:859`); §10's `_authored_section_headings` (`reckon/mcp_views.py:2080`) and `_store._wrapper_section_heading` (`reckon/_store.py:846`) then resolve the wrapper→heading rule twice, once soup-based and once regex-based, and the two must agree on which wrappers qualify with no parity check between them

findings.reason: §10's done-when should cover every reader of "where is this section's heading", and the attach path re-exposes the bug §10 closed.
findings.text: `_require_heading_for_section_records` locates a section's heading with `find_all("h2", id=True)`, so a plan whose id sits on a wrapping `<section id="s2"><h2>` (exactly the shape §10 was raised for by nova's S21) is refused a record attach with "no authored h2 heading with id 's2' although the heading is in the file", even though §10's collapse and section-read paths resolve that same id — the wrapper resolution now exists in three readers (`_store._section_heading`, `_store._wrapper_section_heading`, `mcp_views._authored_section_headings`) and this fourth did not receive the fix

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the typed section record is one shape parsed in `_plan_html.read_state`, regenerated in `write_state`, validated through one shared `SectionRecord` helper (`reckon/_store.py:1652`), and the impl coverage rule is owned once in `derive_impl_from_sections` (`reckon/_plan_html.py:318`) and imported by the store refusal (`reckon/_store.py:2513`), the writer gate (`_impl_is_carried_by_records`) and both read paths; the two attempt readers funnel through one `_group_section_attempts` (`reckon/mcp_views.py:1590`), the indexed path delegating to it (`:1760`) and on error (`:1753`).
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §10 added a second reader for "a section id carried on a wrapper" and a second spelling of the structured-region predicate instead of extending the owners already in `reckon/_store.py`; and one heading-locator was left on the h2-only rule §10 exists to fix.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan searched and cites the mechanisms it extends: `parse_plan_ref` and the existing `depends_on` grammar for refs (§6), `gated_sections` on gates, the JSON Schema reckon already publishes (§1), and the recorded S22 reuse map (comment c-run-r-20260924T203913190997-s22-reuse-map); §14 unified four existing spellings of the executable-role set rather than adding a fifth.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the refusal, warning and derivation layers all delegate to shared helpers (`_new_section_record`, `_section_contract_refusal`, `derive_impl_from_sections`) rather than wrapping the same machinery in a parallel copy; §13's cache adds measured behaviour (8s→1.5s) over the aggregation, not a pass-through.
